title: ElevenLabs API key (sk_): one-property twin (length)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 47 hex characters vs the 48 the tools and samples corroborate and length: 49 hex characters vs the 48 the tools and samples corroborate. Twin of "ElevenLabs API key (sk_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. The outcome shows how the changed property is treated.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T0: the evidence is unresolved and the fixtures were unscored, so no outcome is asserted. Not asserted: disputed property — the length and alphabet of the sk_ body (48 lowercase hexadecimal characters), which no provider-owned source states. No provider-owned source decides it and the research pass recorded it as searched-and-not-found, so the benchmark stops asserting it (docs/decisions/2026-09-24-stop-asserting-provider-undecided-format-properties.md). Kept as history; the product's behaviour on this property is unmeasured for elevenlabs-api-key.
